==== tluaInstantiationStatement.tlua (1 errors) ====
    declare function makeGeneric(): <T>(value: T) => T;
    declare id: <T>(value: T) => T;
    
    // The instantiation erases in emit, leaving a plain call statement.
    makeGeneric()<number>;
    
    // Erases to a bare name, which Lua does not admit as a statement.
    id<number>;
